specification.monitor_palette_control: Baseline monitors accept vertical-retrace palette commands. From NCC June 1982, explicitly capable Color Pro monitors also accept bounded horizontal-retrace commands under technology.scanline_palette_list; do not send these to legacy monitors.

control_channel.implementation: Host firmware performs selection using controller control-channel registers; monitor fixed capability ROM/straps and serializer.
startup: Read versioned capability record with integrity check and timeout
Intersect host and monitor raster support
control_channel.failure_policy: Use an explicitly configured profile or documented common safe raster; otherwise remain blank. Never infer 640-pixel support from connection alone.
control_channel.electrical_status: External drivers/transceivers; voltage, termination, connector pinout, turnaround, timeout and packet encoding remain qualification gates. No hot-plug guarantee.

specification.raster_status: Legacy 200-line targets approximately 15.70 kHz / 59.92 Hz. Mono Pro 640×400 target 26.88 kHz / 60 Hz progressive. Porch/sync widths, polarity and analog qualification remain release gates.
specification.scaling: Integer horizontal/vertical pixel repetition, including sprites. 160/320-wide logical modes can repeat to 320/640; 100 lines repeat to 200. Reject 640-wide graphics or 80-column text on a 320-only monitor; software viewport is a separately reported service. Artemis card repeats legacy pixels/lines to 640×400 for Mono Pro; never downscales 400 lines to an old monitor.
specification.palette_mapping: Explicit 1-bit and 2-bit pixel-to-output-index maps. Color indices are not brightness values. On grayscale displays map RGB palette entries to luminance; Mono I direct DAC requires host index mapping.
